catalog.name: Sieve of Eratosthenes (full enumeration)
catalog.note: Generates all primes up to N then counts; O(N log log N) time, O(N) space.

catalog.name: Segmented sieve
catalog.note: Process sqrt(N)-sized segments; same time, space O(sqrt N).

catalog.name: Wheel-mod-30 sieve (E2.1 wheel realization)
catalog.note: Same exponents as segmented; wheel gives 8/30 storage constant (Mertens product) but no exponent change.

catalog.name: Aggarwal binary search on pi (E6.6)
catalog.note: p(n) reduces to O(log n) calls to pi(x); each pi(x) call inherits floor-pillar cost. Effective exponent here reflects the BEST currently-attached pi(x) sub-routine (HKM at floor pillar). Logged on prime pillar because the algorithm OUTPUT is a prime position, not pi.

catalog.name: Direct explicit-formula evaluation
catalog.note: Requires zeros up to height T ~ x^{1/2+eps} for exact pi(x); each zero costs O(polylog) once tabulated. Storing N(T) ~ T log T zeros in O(log T) bits gives S ~ x^{1/2+eps}.

catalog.name: Galway 2004 zero-driven pi(x)
catalog.note: Best published zero-pillar method for exact pi(x); same order as direct explicit-formula.

catalog.name: Odlyzko-Schoenhage zeta evaluation
catalog.note: Amortized O(T^{1/2}) per zeta evaluation at T heights. A primitive used by zero-pillar algorithms; not itself a pi(x) algorithm but bounds the zero-pillar exponent.

catalog.name: Connes operator one-shot fit (S53)
catalog.note: Recovers 50 zeros from primes <= 13 to 10^{-55..-3} as a one-shot fit; not a polylog algorithm. Listed for completeness on the zero pillar.

catalog.name: Lucy DP basic
catalog.note: Direct DP over { floor(x/k) }; T = O(x^{3/4}), S = O(sqrt x).

catalog.name: Lucy + Fenwick tree update
catalog.note: Log-update Fenwick tree drops time to O(x^{2/3} log^{1/3} x).

catalog.name: Meissel-Lehmer (classical)
catalog.note: Phi(x, a) recursion; cube-root-space variant is Meissel-Lehmer.

catalog.name: Gourdon variant
catalog.note: Two-parameter family; same T as Lucy+Fenwick, refined constants.

catalog.name: primecount (Walisch / Kim production)
catalog.note: Engineering ceiling of the sieve route; same Big-O as Lucy+Fenwick / Gourdon, multi-level POPCNT counter.

catalog.name: HKM (Helfgott-Kessler-Mendlovic)
catalog.note: NTT-accelerated Dirichlet convolution; T = O~(x^{8/15}), S = O~(x^{1/3}). Best simultaneously sub-x^{2/3} time AND sub-x^{1/2} space algorithm known.
